changelog:
v4.2.18 — A new look for series, and real episode names

• Series pages are redesigned. One button picks up where you left off ("Resume S1 E3, 23 min left") or starts the next episode, with Start over beside it. Seasons are listed down the left, and episodes show their length, a progress bar, and which ones you've already watched.

• Episodes now show their real names (for example "Tape 1, Side A") instead of "Episode 1", for shows we can match.

• The next-episode card at the end of an episode is easier to use. It shows the next episode's picture and name, appears 20 seconds before the end, and the Play now button empties as the countdown runs. The selected button is now clearly highlighted, and pressing Back cancels it and keeps you on the episode you're watching.

Includes everything from v4.2.17: the move to the new server, with your login, favorites and Continue Watching carried over.
